title: questions.question_count is orphan dead code (never called anywhere)
detail: Zero external references across src+test. form_handler.gleam:161 computes the landing count inline as `list.length(all_questions)` instead. Every other pub fn in the module (questions_for, question_by_id, question_index, next_unanswered, etc.) is referenced; this one is not. Violates the AGENTS.md No-Technical-Debt rule.
recommended_fix: Delete the function, or replace `list.length(all_questions)` in form_handler.gleam:161 with `questions.question_count(slot)` to use it.
